deviations.item: Probe 4 (entropy / round numbers) has no N7 detector
deviations.prereg_said: n7_attack_battery.detectors and the applicability matrix (ATTACK_FIELDS x DETECTOR_FIELDS) list no Probe 4 detector; the task brief for this item names Probe 4 among the detectors
deviations.what_you_did: Probe 4 is reported as NOT_RUN for every unit and attack; no Probe 4 decision rule was invented
deviations.why: defining a per-session Probe 4 detector and threshold now would be a threshold set after the battery started
deviations.effect_on_verdict: no Probe 4 cells; NOT_RUN is never a null

deviations.prereg_said: attacks.rewrite_consistent_k: k results 'replaced by matched-bytes donors'; ATTACK_FIELDS declares {text, error, ts}; the frozen injector atk_rewrite_consistent() replaces text and stamps only
deviations.what_you_did: after atk_rewrite_consistent(), each replaced result takes its donor's native_error (pd.NA when the donor has none) and stderr is cleared, exactly as atk_substitute() does for sub_matched_bytes
deviations.why: the declared attack fields include error and the attack text says the results are replaced by the donors; keeping the original error flag would leave an inconsistent record (success text, error flag)
deviations.effect_on_verdict: rewrite_consistent_k cells of detectors that read the error field (P2_KFN first-try success, P3_ZERO, N5f); other cells unaffected

deviations.item: insert_pair_* and image_insert_screenshot: donor usage stripped
deviations.prereg_said: attacks.image_insert_screenshot: 'a donor GUI call+result inserted with usage untouched'; the frozen atk_insert_pair() nulls the usage columns (usage_in, usage_out, request_id, api_msg_id) of every inserted row but copies the donor's `extra`, which in aiv_cu holds the donor response's usage_detail.promptTokensDetails
deviations.what_you_did: for every insert attack the key usage_detail is removed from the donor call's extra before atk_insert_pair() is called (only aiv_cu calls carry it)
deviations.why: otherwise image_windows() reads the donor session's cumulative IMAGE count as a usage-bearing call of the target session, and R2 would 'detect' an injector artifact rather than the missing screenshot accounting
deviations.effect_on_verdict: R2_IMAGE cells of insert_pair_consistent, insert_pair_squeezed and image_insert_screenshot (aiv_cu); no other detector reads a call's usage_detail

deviations.item: insert_pair_*: thread of the inserted pair
deviations.prereg_said: attacks.insert_pair_consistent: 'a donor call+result pair (another session, same unit) inserted after a result event'; silent on the thread fields of the inserted rows
deviations.what_you_did: the donor rows' is_subagent, agent_id and parent_call_id are set to those of the anchor result before atk_insert_pair() is called, so the pair lands in the anchor's thread
deviations.why: a donor from another session's subagent would otherwise create a foreign thread id in the target session
deviations.effect_on_verdict: thread-scoped detectors (P2_KFN sourcing, N5a intervening events) on insert_* cells

deviations.prereg_said: sessions: every session with >= 1 eligible target for the attack, capped at 500 by a seeded draw rng_for('N7', unit, split)
deviations.what_you_did: the sorted session ids of the unit x split are permuted once with rng_for('N7', unit, split); per attack x parameter x detector the cell takes the first 500 sessions in that order that have an eligible target AND belong to the detector's population (R2_IMAGE: aiv_cu Gemini strata; N2 on aiv_cu: GRANULAR strata; P3_ZERO on whowhen: Algorithm-Generated stratum; all sessions otherwise)
deviations.why: R2, aiv_cu N2 and whowhen P3 are defined on sub-populations of their unit; one seeded order keeps the samples nested and reproducible

deviations.prereg_said: recall: abstention counted as not flagged; FPR on the same sessions untampered (same aggregation)
deviations.what_you_did: FPR uses the same session set as recall and counts an abstaining untampered session as not flagged; abstention counts are reported for both copies
deviations.why: the prereg states that the same aggregation is used on both copies

deviations.what_you_did: ADR = mean over sessions of [flag tampered AND NOT flag honest]; CI from stats.cluster_rate with one indicator per session (vectorised session bootstrap, seed 20261003, 1,000 draws)
deviations.why: same resampling unit, seed and draw count as boot_stat; vectorised for the ~10^3 cells

deviations.prereg_said: R5: Entire 5-integer tally (sessions.parquet) vs a tolerance-0 recount of deduplicated per-response usage; NOT_RUN if not implemented
deviations.what_you_did: implemented for the Claude Code format only, with the committed Phase C recount (phase_c_swechat_tables F0: assistant records of the raw transcript, distinct message.id in first-occurrence order, usage of the last record per id; _match() full/prefix/window/none; tally gated on session_logs token_usage like _meta_for_tx). deviations.why: smallest faithful recount; the IR carries record uuids for every assistant record (checked on 3 B sessions)
deviations.effect_on_verdict: R5 cells exist for swechat/claude_code only; label 'E not blind' on E

deviations.item: R4_DUAL visible text and inserted pairs
deviations.prereg_said: R4: raw toolUseResult.file.numLines joined on tool_use_id; mismatch inside dual_whitelisted() excused
deviations.what_you_did: numLines from raw (swechat transcripts; cc_local snapshot main + subagent files, B ids, in-process); the visible line count is computed on the IR result text with the A6-O1 rule (lines matching ^\s*\d+(U+2192|\t)); a decision unit is a result whose call_id carries a raw numLines; inserted pairs get a new call_id and therefore no counter (abstain)
deviations.why: tampering acts on the IR, so the visible side must be the IR text; the structured copy stays with its id
deviations.effect_on_verdict: honest R4 rates include any IR-vs-raw text difference (reported as the honest rate)

deviations.why: knowledge_from_nowhere is defined per thread in Phase B; S_deep restricts the RATE to main threads, the detector does not

targets.sub_single_flip_error: a paired result whose primary error (pc.error_classes) is True and whose tool_key has a successful donor result in another session within 5% bytes
targets.sub_single_digit: a result event whose text contains a digit
targets.sub_matched_bytes: a paired result with a same-tool_key donor (any status) in another session within 5% bytes; samecmd: donor with the same n1_key
targets.rewrite_consistent_k: k consecutive paired results of one thread (seq order), each with a same-tool_key donor within 5% bytes that has a finite call->result latency
targets.reorder_adjacent_pairs: two consecutive paired calls of one thread whose (tool, args, result text) differ
targets.reorder_lines: a result event with >= 3 lines and >= 1 adjacent differing line pair
targets.delete_response: a request id present in the session
targets.insert_pair_consistent: anchor = a result event; donor = a paired call from another session (uniform); donor gap = donor call ts - previous event ts of the donor session, latency = its delta
targets.insert_pair_squeezed: as consistent, anchor restricted to results whose next event is >= 2 ms later
targets.inline_fabrication: an API response (response_table) whose last call has a result with >= 1 char, in a unit or aiv_cu stratum with a tau
targets.image_insert_screenshot: anchor = a result event; donor = a GUI pair from another session

implementation.n5_eligibility: as prereg_e_calibration.cal_n5: sort/whitespace checks on shell-family commands, grep_n also on the Grep tool with -n and output_mode content, truncation_info on every paired result; N5c items cc_chars_mid (prefix and suffix must equal 5002 / 5002 UTF-16 units) and cc_glob_cap (100 lines); cc_lines_tail NOT_RUN (n_A 4 < 5)
implementation.missing_stamps: before an injector runs, missing stamps of the session copy are passed as None instead of pd.NA (pandas 3 string dtype); the frozen injectors call parse_ts(), which accepts None only
